actualPrompts.prompt: Historical-scene illustration in the waters near Xiamen during the 1630 fighting. On the foreground deck a Chinese messenger leans urgently forward with one arm stretched to stop a cannon crewman; the gunner has withdrawn the hand that was ready to ignite the cannon. Beyond them, an approaching allied Chinese boat has turned slightly, allowing its white recognition flag to open fully and show exactly three black circular dots, no letters or other symbols. The first uncertainty is resolving; the cannon does not fire. Zheng Zhilong is NOT in this image. The anonymous messenger is a stocky older man with a round broad face, short beard, worn rust-brown clothes and a tan headcloth, visibly different from the young slim indigo-clad protagonist. The gunner is another distinct man. Sailors have varied ordinary Fujian faces, coarse indigo and brown work clothes, Ming tied hair under cloth wraps. A moderate veil of smoke still allows the flag and spatial relation of boats to remain legible; ship and cannon details are cautious period generalizations. Compose over the cannon toward the unfolding flag, bright gray coastal daylight with blue-gray water, restrained oil-and-gouache realism. One 3:2 landscape painting, no collage, no text or readable banners except the three plain dots, no modern guns, no Qing queues, no tricorns, no graphic injury, no watermark. Do not copy a later battle painting as an eyewitness view.

Historical-scene illustration at a Fujian landing in 1630. Six-year-old Fukumatsu, the future Zheng Chenggong, has just arrived from Japan and steadies himself with one hand on his father's shoulder while stepping into a small shoe. Zheng Zhilong crouches awkwardly and holds the shoe, having carefully put back the folded cloth the child's mother placed inside to prevent rubbing. A modest cloth travel bundle rests nearby, a wooden boat and gangplank behind them. Zheng is a young man in his mid-to-late twenties, becoming sturdier but still recognizably the long oval-faced Fujian sailor, straight brows, deep eyes, slightly broad nostrils and a subtle fine moustache, wearing a plain dark Ming robe and cloth-bound tied hair. The boy has short dark hair or simple childhood tied hair, a slender oval face and straight brows resembling his father, small travel clothes appropriate to a child; never depict him as an adult general. Low intimate composition at the child's height, clear soft daylight, gray stone, brown boat and muted indigo, restrained oil-and-gouache realism. One 3:2 landscape image, no collage, no text, no Qing queues, no weapons, no watermark. Private family reconstruction. Reference image is for visual style and character continuity only: match its naturalistic historical realism, tactile materials, subtle painterly restraint and clear daylight. Where Zheng appears, preserve the young man gripping the rope in the reference as the same face, aged only as specified here. Change the setting, pose, cast and composition completely to the requested new moment; do not repeat the cargo-hoisting scene. Render exactly one independent 3:2 landscape illustration.

reviews.reason: 参考图人物带入过强：传令者外观与芝龙首图近乎相同。认旗及停炮动作成立，但重做为清楚区分的匿名传令者，使用文字风格约束。
已实际检视：空席居中，赏袍与伞陈设，郑与欧洲来客及侧方低语形成场面。明制束发而无清辫；无现代物件、无可读伪史料。座次和面貌只是文学重建，非真实仪式复原。
重做后传令者为褐衣宽脸中年人，与首图芝龙区别清楚；炮手火绳已退开，白旗确有三个黑点，船未被画作已经中炮。海岸和船炮为概括形态。
父子人物与扶肩穿鞋动作成立，但岸上多了一只无来由的同类鞋，定点移除后采用。
